CREATE TABLE "public"."conversation_participants" (
  "conversation_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "joined_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "last_read_at" timestamptz,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversations" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'DIRECT' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "conversations_status_check_f94a3a5d" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'CLOSED')),
  CONSTRAINT "conversations_type_check_88fadaa3" CHECK ("type" IN ('DIRECT', 'GROUP'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."messages" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "conversation_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "message_type" text DEFAULT 'TEXT' NOT NULL,
  "sender_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "messages_message_type_check_ca908fbd" CHECK ("message_type" IN ('TEXT', 'IMAGE', 'FILE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."service_request_images" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "display_order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_key" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "service_request_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."service_request_providers" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "matched_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "provider_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "service_request_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'MATCHED' NOT NULL,
  "viewed_at" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "service_request_providers_status_check_b3894f35" CHECK ("status" IN ('MATCHED', 'VIEWED', 'QUOTED', 'DECLINED', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."service_requests" (
  "address_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "available_time_from" time NOT NULL,
  "available_time_to" time NOT NULL,
  "budget_amount" numeric(10,2),
  "budget_type" text NOT NULL,
  "category_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "specific_date" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "subservice_id" uuid,
  "title" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "urgency" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "service_requests_budget_type_check_0f89b5ef" CHECK ("budget_type" IN ('OPEN_BID', 'FIXED')),
  CONSTRAINT "service_requests_status_check_bada4c1d" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'ACCEPTED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')),
  CONSTRAINT "service_requests_urgency_check_6c656154" CHECK ("urgency" IN ('TODAY', 'THIS_WEEK', 'SPECIFIC_DATE', 'FLEXIBLE'))
)
